system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook that installs nginx on a target Ubuntu host, ensures the service is started and enabled at boot, and opens port 80 in the firewall.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook that installs nginx on a target Ubuntu host, ensures the service is started and enabled at boot, and opens port 80 in the firewall.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure nginx on Ubuntu
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    nginx_packages:
      - nginx
    ufw_allowed_ports:
      - { port: 80, proto: tcp, rule: allow, comment: "Allow HTTP traffic" }
      - { port: 22, proto: tcp, rule: allow, comment: "Allow SSH traffic" }

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Verify target host is Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_distribution == "Ubuntu"
        fail_msg: "This playbook only supports Ubuntu hosts. Detected: {{ ansible_distribution }}"
        success_msg: "Ubuntu host detected: {{ ansible_distribution }} {{ ansible_distribution_version }}"

    - name: Update apt package cache
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600

  tasks:
    - name: Install nginx and required packages
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: "{{ nginx_packages }}"
        state: present
      notify: Restart nginx

    - name: Install ufw firewall
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: ufw
        state: present

    - name: Configure UFW default incoming policy
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: incoming
        policy: deny
        state: enabled

    - name: Configure UFW default outgoing policy
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: outgoing
        policy: allow
        state: enabled

    - name: Allow configured ports through UFW
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: "{{ item.rule }}"
        port: "{{ item.port }}"
        proto: "{{ item.proto }}"
        comment: "{{ item.comment | default(omit) }}"
      loop: "{{ ufw_allowed_ports }}"

    - name: Enable UFW
      community.general.ufw:
        state: enabled
        logging: "on"

    - name: Ensure nginx service is started and enabled at boot
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Verify nginx is responding on port 80
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: http://localhost
        status_code: 200
        return_content: false
      register: nginx_health
      retries: 3
      delay: 2
      until: nginx_health.status == 200

  handlers:
    - name: Restart nginx
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: restarted
